req.title: Flaskr uses sqlite as backing store
req.statement: The system shall persist users and posts in a sqlite3 database file named flaskr.sqlite by default.
triggers: flaskr uses sqlite as backing store

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the persistence of users and posts in the sqlite3 database as specified in the requirement. It includes tests for positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_create_user_positive
preconditions: The database is initialized with default data.
actions: Register a new user with valid username and password.
expected: The user is successfully registered and redirected to the login page.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'Kiara', 'password': 'river'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'

tests.name: test_create_user_negative
preconditions: The database is initialized with default data.
actions: Attempt to register a user with an existing username.
expected: An error message indicating the username is already registered.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

r = client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'apple'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'already registered' in r.data

tests.name: test_create_post_boundary
preconditions: The database is initialized with default data.
actions: Create a post with the maximum allowed title and body length.
expected: The post is successfully created and visible on the index page.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
max_title = 'X' * 120
max_body = 'X' * 1000
r = client.post('/create', data={'title': max_title, 'body': max_body})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'

r = client.get('/')
assert max_title.encode() in r.data
assert max_body.encode() in r.data
